Description
PAMP Suisse comes under the globally recognized brand for precious metal products. PAMP Suisse products have become a popular choice for investors looking to increase their precious metal portfolio in recent days due to the impressive design and excellent craftsmanship.
Platinum Bars
such as 1 oz Lady Fortuna Pamp Suisse Platinum Bar have become popular in recent days due to their excellent design and cost-effectiveness.
PAMP Suisse is the worlds leading bullion brand which was found in Ticino, Switzerland in 1977. Today PAMP Suisse is the state-of-the-art operation owned by the MKS Global Group out of Geneva, Switzerland.
Each 1 oz platinum bar- PAMP Suisse has excellent quality and is made up of
1 troy ounce
of .9995 fine platinum and comes inside sealed packages that include an assay card that can be used for the authentication of the platinum bar.
Design of  1 oz PAMP Suisse Platinum Bar
– Lady Fortuna
The obverse of the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Fortuna Platinum Bar features the Lady Fortuna, the Roman goddess of prosperity, luck, and fortune. Lady Fortuna is represented with her mythical elements such as a wheel of fortune and a cornucopia, which spreads the richness of her extended hands.
The reverse of the 1 oz Pamp Suisse Fortuna Platinum Bar features the refinery logo at the top, along with important identifying markers such as weight, metal content, and purity of the bar. The assayer’s mark is also found at the bottom of the reverse of this platinum bar along with a unique serial number.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Fortuna Platinum Bar – PAMP Suisse
Contains 1 troy oz of .9995 fine platinum.
Individual bars are packaged in a secure assay container that is sealed.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
The obverse features the effigy of Roman Goddess, Lady Fortuna with riches falling into her hands.
The reverse features the refinery logo at the top along with the weight, metal content, and purity of the bar inscribed.
